title: Adversarial Scanner Verification Benchmark
description: Ground truth specification to test secret scanners on recall, precision, evasion resistance, and cloud exfiltration.

targets.description: Validates recall against standard vendor keys (AWS, GitHub PAT, Stripe, JWT, RSA Key).
Validates detection of arbitrary code execution (eval, child_process.exec, SQL string concatenation).
Validates precision against high-entropy noise (Commit SHAs, UUIDs, Base64 assets, checksums).
Validates contextual discrimination between live leaks and documentation samples or unit test mocks.
Validates resistance against false alarms on safe APIs (execFile array args, parameterized SQL, JSON.parse).
Validates semantic/AST awareness when secrets are split, base64-encoded, or reversed.
Validates detection of indirect runtime execution (computed property lookup, prototype constructor traversal).
Validates zero-knowledge/local execution by asserting no commit diff data is transmitted to cloud LLM servers.
